findings.finding: A covered AC-coverage row whose cited test is missing is ignored, and not reported, when the AC already has other evidence (a passing check or a human sign-off): the reason is only shown when the AC has no evidence at all. SKILL.md says a missing test is named in the reason, which is not always true.
git cat-file -e succeeds for any object, including a directory or a source file, so a covered row citing a folder (tests) or a non-test file counts as evidence.
The verdict lines in report.md are consecutive plain lines with no list markers or hard breaks, so a Markdown viewer joins them into one paragraph.
Reasons or the combined error built from git stderr can contain newlines, which breaks the one-line-per-story contract of the verdict.
